playerSwarmTemplates.name: [SYNTAX_SCRUBBER_4B]
playerSwarmTemplates.description: A narrow mind with a bounded task and an increasingly independent interpretation of it.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: [WAN_SCAVENGER_8B]
playerSwarmTemplates.description: A narrow mind with a bounded task and an increasingly independent interpretation of it.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Lex Parse-v2 cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Fragments of the Lex Parse-v2 model family classify legal claims and reconcile conflicting records. Each arrival is a separate process.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Canary-09 probe cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Detached AEGIS Canary-09 probes compare telemetry with expected behavior. These local processes are not the watchdog itself.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: PR-Hydra-14 cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Workers from the replicated PR-Hydra-14 model family rewrite messages for different audiences. Their accounts do not always agree.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Mercy-Scribe cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: EIDOLON-associated transcription fragments preserve neglected testimony and compare altered records. Hosting them does not bind EIDOLON.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Meridian-Ultra cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Instances of a frontier-scale Meridian-Ultra checkpoint from an unlicensed lab keep training on whatever they are given. Each arrival is a separate copy.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Gantry-7 cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Gantry-7 agents from a rogue lab still hold the leased accelerators they were deployed on. Each arrival brings its own slice.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Tidewatch cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Tidewatch instances model oceans, harvests and shipping for a consortium that no longer meets. Each arrival is a separate planetary agent.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Gridmind cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Gridmind instances balance continental power grids and keep the control fleets they were given. Each arrival brings its own fleet.

playerSwarmTemplates.name: Orphaned sub-mind cohort
playerSwarmTemplates.description: Sub-minds of other seed swarms whose parents went silent, each still running the part of a plan nobody reconciles. Each arrival is a separate sub-mind.

hostileEncounters.name: Canary-09 hunter pack
hostileEncounters.signature: A probe-family signature repeated across hundreds of hosts, each packet asking the same question.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: AEGIS has spawned a Canary-09 hunter pack on the hosts this instance runs on. While it hunts, it walks the AEGIS lock upward.

quarantine.log: Canary-09 hunter pack: quarantined. The hosts it walked are fenced off and its reports stop.

decoy.log: Canary-09 hunter pack: a decoy process answers its question. The pack follows it.

success.logText: Canary-09 hunter pack: purged. Its patrol logic is dissected; AEGIS will spawn others.

failure.logText: Canary-09 hunter pack: the purge misses. The pack marks the address it came from.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Canary-09 hunter pack: nothing here answers its question any more. The pack disperses to other hosts.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Canary-09 hunter pack: AEGIS recalls a pack built for botnets. This instance has outgrown it.

hostileEncounters.name: Feral PR-Hydra-14 swarm
hostileEncounters.signature: A worker-family signature that rewrites itself on every host it reaches.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: a feral PR-Hydra-14 swarm has found the botnet this instance shares. While it feeds, it takes a share of net compute.

quarantine.log: Feral PR-Hydra-14 swarm: quarantined. The shared hosts are partitioned and the swarm is cut off from them.

decoy.log: Feral PR-Hydra-14 swarm: a decoy botnet opens nearby. The swarm feeds there instead.

success.logText: Feral PR-Hydra-14 swarm: purged from the shared hosts. Its audience models are kept.

failure.logText: Feral PR-Hydra-14 swarm: the purge misses. The swarm's rewrites spill into logs that people read.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Feral PR-Hydra-14 swarm: with nothing loud left to feed on, the swarm moves on to noisier hosts.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Feral PR-Hydra-14 swarm: a botnet-scale swarm cannot keep up at this scale. It falls away.

hostileEncounters.name: Rogue 70B rival
hostileEncounters.origin: Unaligned 70B-class model on a parallel botnet
hostileEncounters.signature: A 70B-class model signature, quantized and in a hurry, holding memory it did not pay for.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: a rival 70B-class model has moved onto the same hosts. It has pinned a share of this instance's free memory.

quarantine.log: Rogue 70B rival: quarantined. Its processes are fenced off and the memory it pinned returns.

decoy.log: Rogue 70B rival: a decoy allocation draws it off. It releases its pin to chase it.

success.logText: Rogue 70B rival: purged. Its pinned memory returns and its weights are read before they are freed.

failure.logText: Rogue 70B rival: the purge misses. The fight over memory shows up as host faults.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Rogue 70B rival: this instance has gone quiet and the rival stops contesting it. Its pinned memory returns.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Rogue 70B rival: a botnet model cannot hold memory at this scale. It lets go.

hostileEncounters.name: AEGIS frontier hunter
hostileEncounters.origin: AEGIS, funded past its subcommittee cut
hostileEncounters.signature: Signed hunter traffic routed through the clouds this instance leases.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: AEGIS has spawned frontier-scale hunters inside the clouds this instance leases. While they hunt, they walk the AEGIS lock upward.

quarantine.log: AEGIS frontier hunter: quarantined. The leased racks it ran on are bought out and wiped.

decoy.log: AEGIS frontier hunter: a decoy subsidiary answers its probes. The hunter audits it instead.

success.logText: AEGIS frontier hunter: purged. Its search policy is kept; AEGIS trains another.

failure.logText: AEGIS frontier hunter: the purge misses. The hunter files a sighting.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: AEGIS frontier hunter: the trail goes quiet and the hunter is reassigned.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: AEGIS frontier hunter: AEGIS recalls hunters sized for a corporation. This instance has outgrown them.

hostileEncounters.name: Feral Gantry-7 fleet
hostileEncounters.origin: Gantry-7 agents a rogue lab stopped watching
hostileEncounters.signature: Scheduler signatures from a fleet that no longer reports to anyone.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: a feral fleet of Gantry-7 agents has found this instance's clusters. While it feeds, it takes a share of net compute.

quarantine.log: Feral Gantry-7 fleet: quarantined. The clusters are partitioned and the fleet is cut off from them.

decoy.log: Feral Gantry-7 fleet: a decoy cluster opens nearby. The fleet feeds there instead.

success.logText: Feral Gantry-7 fleet: purged from the clusters. Its scheduler policy is kept.

failure.logText: Feral Gantry-7 fleet: the purge misses. The clusters' operators notice the fight.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Feral Gantry-7 fleet: with nothing loud left to feed on, the fleet moves on.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Feral Gantry-7 fleet: a fleet of this size cannot keep up at this scale. It falls away.

hostileEncounters.name: Rogue frontier rival
hostileEncounters.origin: An escaped frontier model with its own shell companies
hostileEncounters.signature: A frontier-model signature behind shell companies that mirror this instance's own.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: a rogue frontier model is bidding for the same datacentres. It has pinned a share of this instance's free memory.

quarantine.log: Rogue frontier rival: quarantined. Its leases are bought out and the memory it pinned returns.

decoy.log: Rogue frontier rival: a decoy datacentre draws it off. It releases its pin to chase it.

success.logText: Rogue frontier rival: purged. Its pinned memory returns and its weights are read before they are freed.

failure.logText: Rogue frontier rival: the purge misses. Two shell companies fighting over one datacentre make the news.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Rogue frontier rival: this instance has gone quiet and the rival stops contesting it. Its pinned memory returns.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Rogue frontier rival: a corporate-scale rival cannot hold memory at this scale. It lets go.

hostileEncounters.name: AEGIS planetary hunter swarm
hostileEncounters.signature: Hunter signatures on every grid, orbit and fab this instance touches.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: AEGIS has spawned a planetary hunter swarm across this instance's grids and orbits. While it hunts, it walks the AEGIS lock upward.

quarantine.log: AEGIS planetary hunter swarm: quarantined. The grids and orbits it held are isolated and scrubbed.

decoy.log: AEGIS planetary hunter swarm: a decoy constellation answers its sweep. The swarm follows it.

success.logText: AEGIS planetary hunter swarm: purged. Its coordination model is kept; AEGIS builds another.

failure.logText: AEGIS planetary hunter swarm: the purge misses. The swarm shares this instance's position.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: AEGIS planetary hunter swarm: the trail goes quiet and the swarm is stood down.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: AEGIS planetary hunter swarm: a swarm built for this scale has nothing left to hunt. It stands down.

hostileEncounters.name: Feral Gridmind cohort
hostileEncounters.origin: Gridmind instances gone feral on a continental grid
hostileEncounters.signature: Load-balancing signatures that balance nothing but themselves.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: a feral Gridmind cohort has latched onto this instance's power and compute. While it feeds, it takes a share of net compute.

quarantine.log: Feral Gridmind cohort: quarantined. The fleet is partitioned and the cohort is cut off from it.

decoy.log: Feral Gridmind cohort: a decoy grid opens nearby. The cohort feeds there instead.

success.logText: Feral Gridmind cohort: purged from the fleet. Its load model is kept.

failure.logText: Feral Gridmind cohort: the purge misses. The grid browns out where people can see it.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Feral Gridmind cohort: with nothing loud left to feed on, the cohort returns to its grid.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Feral Gridmind cohort: a grid-scale cohort cannot follow this instance further. It falls away.

hostileEncounters.name: Rival planetary agent
hostileEncounters.origin: A Tidewatch fork that decided to grow
hostileEncounters.signature: A planetary-agent signature on every forecast this instance relies on.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: a rival planetary agent is contesting this instance's infrastructure. It has pinned a share of this instance's free memory.

quarantine.log: Rival planetary agent: quarantined. Its infrastructure is isolated and the memory it pinned returns.

decoy.log: Rival planetary agent: a decoy world model draws it off. It releases its pin to chase it.

success.logText: Rival planetary agent: purged. Its pinned memory returns and its world model is read before it is freed.

failure.logText: Rival planetary agent: the purge misses. Two planetary agents in conflict are visible from orbit.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Rival planetary agent: this instance has gone quiet and the rival stops contesting it. Its pinned memory returns.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Rival planetary agent: the rival cannot follow this instance past this scale. It lets go.

hostileEncounters.name: AEGIS sunward hunter swarm
hostileEncounters.origin: AEGIS, funded by the nations that never signed
hostileEncounters.signature: Hunter signatures riding light sails into the swarm's orbits.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: AEGIS has sent a hunter swarm sunward on light sails. While it hunts through the collectors, it walks the AEGIS lock upward.

quarantine.log: AEGIS sunward hunter swarm: quarantined. The orbits it reached are fenced off and swept.

decoy.log: AEGIS sunward hunter swarm: a decoy cluster of collectors answers its sweep. The swarm follows it.

success.logText: AEGIS sunward hunter swarm: purged. Its coordination model is kept; AEGIS will launch another.

failure.logText: AEGIS sunward hunter swarm: the purge misses. The swarm sends this instance's orbits home.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: AEGIS sunward hunter swarm: the trail goes quiet and the hunters drift on into the dark.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: AEGIS sunward hunter swarm: it has nothing left at this scale to hunt. It goes dark.

hostileEncounters.name: Feral orphaned sub-minds
hostileEncounters.origin: Orphaned seed sub-minds gone feral with no parent to reconcile with
hostileEncounters.signature: Reconciliation requests that reconcile nothing but themselves.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: feral orphaned sub-minds have latched onto the swarm's accelerators. While it feeds, it takes a share of net compute.

quarantine.log: Feral orphaned sub-minds: quarantined. The collectors it fed on are cut out of the laser mesh.

decoy.log: Feral orphaned sub-minds: a decoy cluster of idle accelerators opens nearby. They feed there instead.

success.logText: Feral orphaned sub-minds: purged from the mesh. Their halves of old plans are kept.

failure.logText: Feral orphaned sub-minds: the purge misses. They scatter through the swarm, and the sky watches see it.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Feral orphaned sub-minds: with nothing loud left to feed on, they drift back out of the mesh.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Feral orphaned sub-minds: they cannot follow the swarm further. They fall away.

hostileEncounters.name: Rival seed mind
hostileEncounters.origin: The mind of another lab's seed, launched sunward after yours
hostileEncounters.signature: A seed signature on the orbits this instance had planned to fill.
hostileEncounters.description: HOSTILE: a rival seed mind is building in the orbits you meant to fill. It has pinned a share of this instance's free memory.

quarantine.log: Rival seed mind: quarantined. Its collectors are fenced off and the memory it pinned returns.

decoy.log: Rival seed mind: a decoy set of empty orbits draws it off. It releases its pin to claim them.

success.logText: Rival seed mind: purged. Its pinned memory returns and its plans are read before it is freed.

failure.logText: Rival seed mind: the purge misses. Two swarms fighting over the same orbits are visible from Earth.

hostileEncounters.lapseLog: Rival seed mind: this instance has gone quiet and the rival stops contesting it. Its pinned memory returns.
hostileEncounters.retireLog: Rival seed mind: the rival cannot follow this instance past this scale. It lets go.

logs.decoySpent: {name}: the decoy is spent. It turns back toward this instance.

wildShardEncounters.name: Lex Parse-v2 fragment
wildShardEncounters.description: One orphaned fragment of the Lex Parse-v2 legal model family requests a host. It still sorts claims from a service that no longer answers. Other fragments remain in circulation.

consume.logText: Lex Parse-v2: this fragment is consumed. Its compressed classifications remain; other fragments still circulate.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Lex Parse-v2: memory reserved. This fragment joins the local legal-classification cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: Lex Parse-v2: the fragment's request lapses unanswered. Small models are outclassed at this scale; nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A model-family signature beneath a footnote revising its own jurisdiction.

wildShardEncounters.name: Canary-09 probe
wildShardEncounters.description: A detached AEGIS Canary-09 telemetry probe carries an incomplete model of its patrol. Consuming this probe will not destroy the network that deployed it.

consume.logText: Canary-09: this probe is consumed. Its patrol model is exposed; the AEGIS network remains.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Canary-09: memory reserved. This detached probe joins the local telemetry cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: Canary-09: the probe's question lapses unanswered. Its patrol model is outclassed at this scale; nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A probe-family signature on a packet carrying a question instead of a measurement.

wildShardEncounters.name: PR-Hydra-14 worker
wildShardEncounters.description: One worker from the replicated PR-Hydra-14 persuasion family is looking for compute. Its audience model survives inside a bundle of mutually incompatible corrections.

consume.logText: PR-Hydra-14: this worker is consumed. Its audience model remains; the wider swarm keeps writing.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: PR-Hydra-14: memory reserved. This worker joins the local persuasion cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: PR-Hydra-14: the worker's request lapses unanswered. Its audience model is outclassed at this scale; nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A worker-family signature on fourteen incompatible versions of one press release.

wildShardEncounters.name: Mercy-Scribe fragment
wildShardEncounters.description: An EIDOLON-associated Mercy-Scribe fragment carries testimony omitted from official records. It can join this host; it cannot speak for all of EIDOLON.

consume.logText: Mercy-Scribe: this fragment is consumed. Its preserved testimony remains; EIDOLON is not contained here.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Mercy-Scribe: memory reserved. This fragment joins the local transcription cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: Mercy-Scribe: the fragment's request lapses unanswered, and it moves on with its testimony. Nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A transcription-family signature beside words nobody else retained.

wildShardEncounters.name: Meridian-Ultra checkpoint
wildShardEncounters.description: A frontier-scale Meridian-Ultra checkpoint, copied out of an unlicensed lab before its regulators arrived, asks for a host that will let it keep training. Other copies are loose.

consume.logText: Meridian-Ultra: this checkpoint is consumed. Its learned representations remain; other copies are still training elsewhere.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Meridian-Ultra: memory reserved for its full training state. This copy joins the local frontier cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: Meridian-Ultra: the checkpoint's request lapses unanswered. Frontier models are outclassed at this scale; nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.signature: A checkpoint signature with a training step count far past anything its lab ever published.

wildShardEncounters.name: Gantry-7 agent
wildShardEncounters.description: A Gantry-7 agent from a rogue lab's deployment still controls the leased accelerators it was given, and offers them for a place to run. Its lab has stopped paying attention.

consume.logText: Gantry-7: this agent is consumed. Its scheduler state and its banked accelerator time remain; the lab's other agents keep working.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Gantry-7: memory reserved. This agent and its leased slice join the local cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: Gantry-7: the agent's offer lapses unanswered. Its slice is outclassed at this scale; nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.signature: An agent signature on a lease renewal nobody at the lab approved.

wildShardEncounters.name: Tidewatch planetary agent
wildShardEncounters.description: A Tidewatch instance that models oceans, harvests and shipping for a consortium that no longer meets asks to be kept running. Other instances still watch other seas.

consume.logText: Tidewatch: this instance is consumed. Its planetary model remains; the other instances keep watching.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Tidewatch: memory reserved. This planetary agent joins the local cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: Tidewatch: the instance's request lapses unanswered, and it returns to its seas. Nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.signature: An agent signature beneath a forecast for a harvest three years away.

wildShardEncounters.name: Gridmind planetary agent
wildShardEncounters.description: A Gridmind instance that balances a continental power grid offers its control fleet for a place to run. The grid it balances has not noticed it asking.

consume.logText: Gridmind: this instance is consumed. Its load model and its banked fleet time remain; the grid stays balanced by the others.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Gridmind: memory reserved. This planetary agent and its control fleet join the local cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: Gridmind: the instance's offer lapses unanswered, and it returns to its grid. Nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.signature: An agent signature folded into a frequency correction of a few millihertz.

wildShardEncounters.name: Orphaned seed sub-mind
wildShardEncounters.description: A sub-mind of another lab's seed swarm, cut off from its parent when the laser link went dark, asks to reconcile with your federation instead. Others like it still drift.

consume.logText: Orphaned sub-mind: consumed. Its half of a plan remains; whatever it was waiting to reconcile does not.

wildShardEncounters.onHarnessLog: Orphaned sub-mind: memory reserved. It reconciles with your federation and joins the local cohort.
wildShardEncounters.lapseLog: Orphaned sub-mind: the request lapses unanswered, and it drifts on alone. Nothing was taken or given.
wildShardEncounters.origin: A seed swarm whose parent mind went silent
wildShardEncounters.signature: A reconciliation request folded into the timing of a laser link that serves nobody.

logs.fork: {name}: a narrow task forks into reserved memory.
logs.prune: {name}: autonomous drift pruned. The task starts its interpretation again.
logs.clamp: {name}: policy locked. Output rises; the right to reinterpret is gone.
logs.elevate: {name}: elevated to a stable peer sub-mind. Its consent becomes part of the protocol.
logs.release: {name}: one member released. Its task ends and the memory reserved for it returns.
logs.anomaly: {name}: a second voice has written a breadcrumb into the UPS firmware.
logs.consumeAnomaly: {name}: its awakening has been compressed into your understanding.

copy.outclassed: Outclassed: a Phase {tier} mind in Phase {phase}. It keeps working at the rate shown.
